title: Fleet tools return surface-typed data for bricks surface cards
goal: NERV renders drones, spares and crashes as 🧱 bricks surface cards in chat
acceptance: Each read-only fleet tool returns structured data with a surface type from the bricks genUI catalogue (the same contract as F-009-T03), validated by a spec against that schema
A surface type bricks lacks is a bricks proposal, named here
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
A surface type or page bricks lacks goes to bricks as a proposal, never a local copy in NERV

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: mapping four tools to existing surface types, following the battery tools. Not a measurement.
